neighbours.label: ' of' / determiner after a word of command or control (captain of, controlled, Imperial navy)
fire: The captain of the fishing boat ordered everyone below deck.
Captains of merchant ships were fined for carrying stowaways.
Who is the captain of the ship when the storm arrives?
The commander of the fleet sent three cruisers to the strait.
The river was controlled by a series of old stone dams.
The Imperial Navy lost four carriers in a single battle.
The master of the vessel kept a careful log of every port.
The governor of the colony ruled the island for ten years.
quiet: The cook on the fishing boat made soup for everyone below deck.
Sailors on merchant ships often wrote letters home from port.
Who will be on the ship when the storm arrives tonight?
The fleet sailed through the strait in heavy rain last night.
The river flowed past a series of old stone mills.
The navy lost four carriers in a single battle near the islands.
The passengers on the vessel kept careful diaries of every port.
Settlers on the island farmed sugar for ten years.
